PF2EATMOSPHEREFORGE.Atmospheres.forest.c: Quiet light rests among the trees.
The forest feels peaceful for a moment.
Soft shadows gather near the trunks.
Soft sounds travel through the surroundings.
A distant tapping fades among the trees.
The wind moves across the forest floor.
A small trail fades at the edge of the scene.
An old object lies half-hidden.
The trunks show pale wear.
It smells of forest floor and cool air.
A clean, dry scent lingers here.
The wind brings a faint smell of earth.
PF2EATMOSPHEREFORGE.Atmospheres.forest.n: The forest feels active, but hard to judge.
Light breaks unevenly among the trees.
The surroundings feel larger than they first seemed.
A sound stops as soon as you listen closely.
Somewhere, something moves across the forest floor.
A distant noise comes from deeper in the scene.
Fresh tracks lead a short way through the scene.
A marking has only recently been uncovered.
A small object lies oddly neatly.
Moisture and dust mingle in the air.
A heavier scent lies beneath the ordinary.
The forest floor smells freshly disturbed.
PF2EATMOSPHEREFORGE.Atmospheres.forest.t: The forest suddenly feels too still.
The surroundings seem to narrow.
The place feels watchful.
A sound follows you and then cuts off.
Something scratches just out of sight.
A dull noise comes from far away.
A trail ends abruptly in the middle of the scene.
A fresh crack runs across the forest floor.
A dark scrap hangs from the trunks.
A metallic scent lies beneath dust and earth.
The air smells cold and stale.
Something rotten mixes with the wind.
PF2EATMOSPHEREFORGE.Atmospheres.forest.n: The forest no longer feels entirely real.
The surroundings lie wrongly in space.
Shadows linger a moment too long.
A whisper comes from several directions at once.
Your echo answers with a strange delay.
A sound resembles wet scraping.
A shadow moves without a matching body.
A marking changes when you blink.
The forest floor bears tracks leading backward.
It smells of cold ash and old blood.
A sweet smell of decay hangs motionless.
The air tastes metallic and stale.

Clouds mute the light and drain warmth from the colors.
A gray veil lies over the scene.
Rain draws dark lines across every surface.
Wet drumming settles over every other sound.
The storm pulls at everything not firmly anchored.
Gusts lash through the area and swallow quiet sounds.
Fog devours distance and makes nearby things appear without warning.
Mist softens every outline into uncertainty.
Snow muffles the world and lays cold silence over the place.
White flakes gather in cracks, tracks, and open ground.

The sinking sun lengthens every outline.
